en: hard to avoid falling into this house / trap (metaphor)
fr: difficile d'éviter de tomber dans cette maison / ce piège
ur: اس مقام (حالت) میں گرنے سے بچنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: (Specific metaphorical usage). Phrase used when a person is destined to end up in a specific state of life, status, or house regardless of their efforts.
example_ar: القَدَرُ غَالِبٌ وَمِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَفَادِي الوُقُوعِ فِي هَذَا المَنْزَلِ.
example_en: Fate is dominant and it is hard to avoid falling into this house (state).

en: on a specialized educational and athletic scale
fr: à une échelle éducative et athlétique spécialisée
ur: مخصوص تعلیمی اور کھیلوں کی سطح پر
definition_en: Phrase describing an approach to training youth that focuses on both high-level academic study and professional sports excellence.
example_ar: نُدَرِّبُ الشَّبَابَ عَلَى نِطَاقٍ تَرْبَوِيٍّ رِيَاضِيٍّ مُتَخَصِّصٍ.
example_en: We train youth on a specialized educational and athletic scale.

en: at this final and pivotal stage
fr: à cette phase charnière finale
ur: اس آخری اور کلیدی مرحلے پر
definition_en: Phrase focusing on the absolute last turning point before a result is reached, after which no further changes can be made.
example_ar: نَحْنُ الآنَ فِي هَذِهِ المَرْحَلَةِ المِفْصَلِيَّةِ النِّهَائِيَّةِ.
example_en: We are now at this final and pivotal stage.

en: without any prior official political commitment
fr: sans aucun engagement politique officiel préalable
ur: کسی بھی پیشگی سرکاری سیاسی عہد کے بغیر
definition_en: (Double emphatic). Stresses that no government papers were signed or official words spoken that forced a decision.
example_ar: اِتُّخِذَ المَوْقِفُ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ تَعَهُّدٍ سِيَاسِيٍّ رَسْمِيٍّ.
example_en: The position was taken without any prior official political commitment.

en: from a purely organizational and constitutional perspective
fr: d'un point de vue purement organisationnel et constitutionnel
ur: خالص تنظیمی اور آئینی لحاظ سے
definition_en: Phrase narrowing the discussion strictly to how an action matches the supreme law of the land (the constitution).
example_ar: الفِعْلُ صَحِيحٌ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ تَنْظِيمِيَّةٍ دُسْتُورِيَّةٍ صِرْفَةٍ.
example_en: The act is correct from a purely organizational and constitutional perspective.

front: فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ المَلْمُوسِ حَالاً جِدًّا
normalized_front: في المدى المنظور القريب الملموس حالا جدا
en: in the near foreseeable future tangible right now very soon
fr: dans l'avenir prévisible proche tangible dès maintenant très bientôt
ur: اسی وقت بہت جلد محسوس ہونے والے قریب ترین مستقبل میں
definition_en: (Hepta-emphatic). Refers to physical results that are literally happening in front of our eyes at this moment.
example_ar: سَيَتَغَيَّرُ العَالَمُ فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ المَلْمُوسِ حَالاً جِدًّا.
example_en: The world will change in the near foreseeable future tangible right now very soon.

front: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ النَّفْسِيَّةِ العَمِيقَةِ
normalized_front: بغض النظر عن الاعتبارات النفسية العميقة
en: regardless of deep psychological considerations
fr: quelles que soient les considérations psychologiques profondes
ur: گہرے نفسیاتی مفادات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a decision ignores hidden traumas, complex emotions, or subconscious fears, focusing only on cold reality.
example_ar: اِخْتَرْ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ النَّفْسِيَّةِ العَمِيقَةِ.
example_en: Choose regardless of deep psychological considerations.

en: on the verge of total disappearance / vanishing
fr: sur le point de la disparition totale
ur: مکمل طور پر مٹ جانے (غائب ہونے) کے دہانے پر
definition_en: Phrase describing something that is about to become 100% gone, leaving no trace behind in existence or memory.
example_ar: القَبِيلَةُ عَلَى وَشْكِ التَّلاشِي الكُلِّيِّ.
example_en: The tribe is on the verge of total disappearance.

en: at your own scientific and technical discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion scientifique et technique
ur: آپ کی اپنی سائنسی اور فنی صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Combines the precision of hard data with the skilled eye of an expert practitioner.
example_ar: اِحْكُمْ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ العِلْمِيِّ الفَنِّيِّ.
example_en: Judge at your own scientific and technical discretion.

en: in case ecological clarification is requested
fr: en cas de demande de clarification écologique
ur: ماحولیاتی (ایکولوجیکل) وضاحت طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when a scientist or environmentalist needs the ecosystem balance explained further.
example_ar: قَدِّمِ الخَرَائِطَ فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ التَّوْضِيحِ الإِيكُولُوجِيِّ.
example_en: Present the maps in case ecological clarification is requested.
related: إِذَا سَأَلُوا عَنِ الطَّبِيعَةِ, لِلشَّرْحِ البِيئِيِّ

front: عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ المُنْبَعِثَةِ مِنْ بَيْنِ الرُّكَامِ بَعْدَ اليَأْسِ
normalized_front: على مدى الجيال المنبعثة من بين الركام بعد اليأس
en: over generations rising from the rubble after despair
fr: au fil des générations surgissant des décombres après le désespoir
ur: مایوسی کے بعد ملبے سے ابھرنے والی نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Dramatic temporal phrase used to describe a people who found hope and rebuilt their society after a period of total darkness and loss.
example_ar: عَادَتِ الحَيَاةُ عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ المُنْبَعِثَةِ مِنْ بَيْنِ الرُّكَامِ بَعْدَ اليَأْسِ.
example_en: Life returned over generations rising from the rubble after despair.
related: طِوَالَ سِنِي الأَمَلِ الجَدِيدِ, بَعْدَ الصَّدْمَةِ

en: for the purpose of emotional winning over / manipulation
fr: à des fins de séduction émotionnelle / de manipulation
ur: جذباتی طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to play on someone's feelings (pity, love, or anger) to get them to agree with a point or side.
example_ar: بَكَى بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ العَاطِفِيَّةِ.
example_en: He cried for the purpose of emotional winning over.

en: in the thirty-fifth place / thirty-fifthly
fr: en trente-cinquième lieu
ur: پینتیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the thirty-fifth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الخَامِسِ وَالثَّلَاثِينَ، التَّصْنِيعُ.
example_en: And thirty-fifthly, manufacturing.

front: بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّبَاينِ اللُّغَوِيِّ
normalized_front: بما لا يدع مجالا للتباين اللغوي
en: linguistically unified / leaving no room for language disparity
fr: linguistiquement unifié / ne laissant aucune place à la disparité linguistique
ur: جس میں لسانی تفاوت (زبان کے فرق) کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a communication system or a textbook that explains everything so perfectly that even people with different dialects understand exactly the same thing.
example_ar: كُتِبَ الدَّلِيلُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّبَاينِ اللُّغَوِيِّ.
example_en: The guide was written leaving no room for language disparity.

en: for the sake of distant / long-term strategic interest
fr: par intérêt stratégique lointain / à long terme
ur: دور رس تزویراتی (سٹراٹیجک) مفاد کی خاطر
definition_en: Phrase used to justify actions that are taken for a goal that is many years or decades away, requiring great patience.
example_ar: نُخَطِّطُ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَصْلَحَةِ الاِسْتِرَاتِيجِيَّةِ البَعِيدَةِ.
example_en: We plan for the sake of distant strategic interest.

front: مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَفَادِي الوُقُوعِ فِي هَذَا المَطَبِّ
normalized_front: من الصعب تفادي الوقوع في هذا المطب
en: hard to avoid falling into this pitfall / bump (metaphor)
fr: difficile d'éviter de tomber dans ce piège / ce cahot
ur: اس غلطی (گڑھے) میں گرنے سے بچنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used when a specific error or difficulty is so common and easy to make that almost everyone falls for it.
example_ar: هَذَا خَطَأٌ شَائِعٌ وَمِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَفَادِي الوُقُوعِ فِي هَذَا المَطَبِّ.
example_en: This is a common mistake and it is hard to avoid falling into this pitfall.

en: on a comprehensive educational and technological scale
fr: à une échelle éducative et technologique complète
ur: ہمہ گیر تعلیمی اور تکنیکی سطح پر
definition_en: Phrase describing an approach to modern teaching that uses every possible high-tech tool to educate students.
example_ar: نُدَرِّسُ الآنَ عَلَى نِطَاقٍ تَرْبَوِيٍّ تِكْنُولُوجِيٍّ شَامِلٍ.
example_en: We are teaching now on a comprehensive educational and technological scale.

en: at this existential and pivotal stage
fr: à cette phase charnière existentielle
ur: اس وجودی اور کلیدی مرحلے پر
definition_en: Phrase focusing on a turning point in time where the very survival of a person, a country, or a species is at stake.
example_ar: البَشَرِيَّةُ فِي هَذِهِ المَرْحَلَةِ المِفْصَلِيَّةِ الوُجُودِيَّةِ.
example_en: Humanity is at this existential and pivotal stage.
related: وَقْتٌ حَيَوِيٌّ لِلْبَقَاءِ, نُقْطَةُ حَيَاةٍ أَوْ مَوْتٍ

en: without any prior explicit political commitment
fr: sans aucun engagement politique explicite préalable
ur: کسی بھی پیشگی واضح سیاسی عہد کے بغیر
definition_en: (Double emphatic). Stresses that no clear, written, or spoken promises were made by politicians before an action was taken.
example_ar: تَغَيَّرَ الحَالُ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ تَعَهُّدٍ سِيَاسِيٍّ صَرِيحٍ.
example_en: The situation changed without any prior explicit political commitment.

en: from a purely organizational and social perspective
fr: d'un point de vue purement organisationnel et social
ur: خالص تنظیمی اور سماجی لحاظ سے
definition_en: Phrase narrowing the discussion strictly to how people are grouped and how social rules are applied within a community.
example_ar: القَانُونُ جَيِّدٌ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ تَنْظِيمِيَّةٍ اِجْتِمَاعِيَّةٍ صِرْفَةٍ.
example_en: The law is good from a purely organizational and social perspective.

front: فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ المَلْمُوسِ فَوْرًا جِدًّا
normalized_front: في المدى المنظور القريب الملموس فورا جدا
en: in the near foreseeable future tangible right now very much
fr: dans l'avenir prévisible proche tangible dès maintenant énormément
ur: اسی وقت بہت زیادہ محسوس ہونے والے قریب ترین مستقبل میں
definition_en: (Hepta-emphatic). Refers to physical results that are appearing with massive force and visibility at this very second.
example_ar: سَنَرَى التَّغْيِيرَ فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ المَلْمُوسِ فَوْرًا جِدًّا.
example_en: We will see the change in the near foreseeable future tangible right now very much.

front: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ النَّفْسِيَّةِ العَابِرَةِ لِلأَسَفِ
normalized_front: بغض النظر عن الاعتبارات النفسية العابرة للأسف
en: regardless of unfortunately fleeting psychological considerations
fr: quelles que soient les considérations psychologiques malheureusement éphémères
ur: بدقسمتی سے عارضی نفسیاتی مفادات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a decision must ignore short-term feelings (like fear), even though it is sad to do so, focusing only on facts.
example_ar: اِخْتَرْ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ النَّفْسِيَّةِ العَابِرَةِ لِلأَسَفِ.
example_en: Choose regardless of unfortunately fleeting psychological considerations.

en: on the verge of final disappearance / vanishing
fr: sur le point de la disparition finale
ur: حتمی طور پر مٹ جانے (غائب ہونے) کے دہانے پر
definition_en: Phrase describing something that is about to go away for the last time, with no possibility of it ever returning or being remembered.
example_ar: هَذِهِ اللُّغَةُ عَلَى وَشْكِ التَّلاشِي النِّهَائِيِّ.
example_en: This language is on the verge of final disappearance.

en: at your own objective scientific discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion scientifique objective
ur: آپ کی اپنی معروضی (آبجیکٹیو) سائنسی صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Focuses entirely on the listener's data and measurements, ensuring they are not influenced by personal bias.
example_ar: قَيِّمِ البَحْثَ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ العِلْمِيِّ المَوْضُوعِيِّ.
example_en: Evaluate the research at your own objective scientific discretion.

en: in case hydrological clarification is requested
fr: en cas de demande de clarification hydrologique
ur: آبی (ہائیڈرولوجیکل) وضاحت طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when a water expert needs the river flow, dams, or water distribution explained further.
example_ar: نَحْنُ هُنَا فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ التَّوْضِيحِ الهَيْدْرُولُوجِيِّ.
example_en: We are here in case hydrological clarification is requested.
related: إِذَا سَأَلُوا عَنِ المَاءِ, لِلشَّرْحِ المَائِيِّ

front: عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ المُنْبَعِثَةِ مِنْ بَيْنِ الرُّكَامِ بَعْدَ اليَأْسِ القَاتِلِ
normalized_front: على مدى الجيال المنبعثة من بين الركام بعد اليأس القاتل

ur: مہلک مایوسی کے بعد ملبے سے ابھرنے والی نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: (Double emphatic). Dramatic temporal phrase describing a people who survived a period of such total hopelessness that it almost killed their collective spirit.
example_ar: اِنتَصَرْنَا عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ المُنْبَعِثَةِ مِنْ بَيْنِ الرُّكَامِ بَعْدَ اليَأْسِ القَاتِلِ.
example_en: We triumphed over generations rising from the rubble after deadly despair.
related: طِوَالَ سِنِي الصُّمُودِ المُرِّ, بَعْدَ الإِبَادَةِ

en: for the purpose of professional winning over / networking
fr: à des fins de séduction professionnelle / de réseautage
ur: پیشہ ورانہ طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince a colleague, a boss, or a client to support your work or join your business project.
example_ar: أَرْسَلَ السِّيرَةَ الذَّاتِيَّةَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ المِهَنِيَّةِ.
example_en: He sent the CV for the purpose of professional winning over.

en: in the thirty-sixth place / thirty-sixthly
fr: en trente-sixième lieu
ur: چھتیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the thirty-sixth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ السَّادِسِ وَالثَّلَاثِينَ، الزِّرَاعَةُ.
example_en: And thirty-sixthly, agriculture.

front: بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّبَاينِ الإِثْنِيِّ
normalized_front: بما لا يدع مجالا للتباين الإثني
en: ethnically unified / leaving no room for ethnic disparity
fr: ethniquement unifié / ne laissant aucune place à la disparité ethnique
ur: جس میں نسلی تفاوت (فرق) کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase describing a law or a national anthem so powerful that it makes people forget their different tribal or ethnic backgrounds and act as one.
example_ar: تَوَحَّدَ الشَّعْبُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّبَاينِ الإِثْنِيِّ.
example_en: The people united leaving no room for ethnic disparity.

en: for the sake of local strategic interest
fr: par intérêt stratégique local
ur: مقامی تزویراتی (سٹراٹیجک) مفاد کی خاطر
definition_en: Phrase used to justify an action as being part of a plan that focuses strictly on the future and safety of a specific city or region.
example_ar: فَعَلْنَا ذَلِكَ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَصْلَحَةِ الاِسْتِرَاتِيجِيَّةِ المَحَلِّيَّةِ.
example_en: We did that for the sake of local strategic interest.

front: مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَفَادِي الوُقُوعِ فِي هَذَا الشَّرَكِ
normalized_front: من الصعب تفادي الوقوع في هذا الشرك
en: hard to avoid falling into this snare / net / trap
fr: difficile d'éviter de tomber dans ce piège / ce lacet
ur: اس جال (پھندے) میں گرنے سے بچنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used when a specific deception or a complex social situation is designed like a hunter's net, making escape almost impossible.
example_ar: الحَدِيثُ كَانَ ذَكِيًّا وَمِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَفَادِي الوُقُوعِ فِي هَذَا الشَّرَكِ.
example_en: The talk was clever and it was hard to avoid falling into this snare.

en: on a deep educational and philosophical scale
fr: à une échelle éducative et philosophique profonde
ur: گہری تعلیمی اور فلسفیانہ سطح پر
definition_en: Phrase describing an approach to teaching that forces students to ask the biggest questions about life, reality, and truth.
example_ar: نُفَكِّرُ عَلَى نِطَاقٍ تَرْبَوِيٍّ فَلْسَفِيٍّ عَمِيقٍ.
example_en: We think on a deep educational and philosophical scale.

front: فِي هَذِهِ المَرْحَلَةِ المِفْصَلِيَّةِ الحَسَّاسَةِ لِلْغَايَةِ

definition_en: (Double emphatic). Phrase focusing on a turning point where even a tiny mistake could lead to a massive disaster.
example_ar: اِحْذَرُوا فِي هَذِهِ المَرْحَلَةِ المِفْصَلِيَّةِ الحَسَّاسَةِ لِلْغَايَةِ.
example_en: Be careful at this extremely sensitive and pivotal stage.

en: without any prior absolute political commitment
fr: sans aucun engagement politique absolu préalable
ur: کسی بھی پیشگی مطلق (ٹوٹل) سیاسی عہد کے بغیر
definition_en: (Double emphatic). Stresses that no 100% total or unbreakable promises were made by a government before an event happened.
